description: Give a narrative, step-by-step trace of how ONE feature, endpoint, job, or script works end to end, from entry point through to side effects — grounded in the real execution path, not assumptions. Use when the user asks "how does login work", "how is /api/orders POST processed", "how does this cron job send reminders", "how do invoices get generated", or "walk me through how X works". Not for a quick file:line pointer — use locate-implementation when the user just wants "where is X" with no narrative. Not for whole-repo orientation — use onboard-codebase when the user wants to understand the whole project rather than one flow.
